definitions.explanation: A patient's first visit to a particular doctor or hospital, or the first consultation for a new condition.

examples.japanese: {初診|しょしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}→申し出る：10465_moushideru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: First-time patients, please check in at the reception desk.

examples.japanese: {初診|しょしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{保険証|ほけんしょう}→保険証：09707_hokenshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持参|じさん}して→持参する：21143_jisansuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please bring your insurance card for your first visit.

examples.japanese: {初診|しょしん}{料|りょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{再診|さいしん}→再診：23254_saishin⟧⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: The initial consultation fee is often higher than the follow-up fee.

notes:
USAGE:
{初診|しょしん} is commonly seen on signs and forms at hospitals and clinics in Japan. Patients are typically divided into {初診|しょしん} (first-time) and ⟦{再診|さいしん}→再診：23254_saishin⟧ (returning) at the reception desk.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初診|しょしん}{料|りょう} (initial consultation fee)
- {初診|しょしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧ (first-time patient)
- {初診|しょしん}⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧ (first-visit appointment)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{再診|さいしん}→再診：23254_saishin⟧ (follow-up visit, return visit)
- ⟦{紹介状|しょうかいじょう}→紹介状：23208_shoukaijou⟧ (referral letter — often needed for a first visit to a large hospital)
